items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: every Saturday night Bobby Clarke and I had this little gig up there

ctx.x: No, Charlie was at 3 West 135th which was at Fifth Avenue. 305 was across 8th Avenue and St. Nicholas, 8th and St. Nicholas, 305, and it was a walkup five flights, yeah five flights, and every Saturday night Bobby Clarke and I had this little gig up there, we'd go five dollars, five dollars, and at that time all the drummers were using was 28-inch bass drums which were big. Yeah, of course today they're 20 inches you know, 20, 22, normal size. Well anyway I used to carry these drums up these five flights, get up…
and it was my first full set of drums.
